text: Across the six seed-dataset pairs with matched 6000-step m2-fixed N=64/N=128 runs (seeds 20-23, data_seeds 0-1), is the data_seed 1 to data_seed 0 gap ratio the same for every seed (about 0.60-0.74 for seeds 22-23)? A constant ratio would mean the gap is a per-seed factor scaled by the dataset rather than a pure model-seed property.
